config.sequence_convention: maximal contiguous clean run; first subsequent two-wick candle in same EMA zone; no Doji threshold
config.impulse_count_convention: immediately preceding contiguous same-zone trend-color candles; recorded, not an author minimum
config.intermediate_policy: unrestricted shape until first two-wick candle; censor at another clean run, zone loss, gap, warmup, split or end
config.outcome_status: unavailable; no entry/SL/TP or win/loss labels

quality.closure_policy: No inferred closure calendar. All gaps remain unclassified; no imputation.
